title: Define gf2-algebra Cargo feature-gate matrix
description:
## Context

`gf2-algebra` carries multiple feature-gated paths. This issue settles the feature names, defaults, and combination compatibility rules.

Proposed feature set (input strawman, may be refined here):

- `simd` — turns on `gf2-kernels-simd` SIMD dispatch (default-on)
- `parallel` — turns on `rayon` parallel permanent (default-on)
- `hip` — turns on HIP/ROCm GPU dispatch (default-off; opt-in like `gf2-kernels-hip`)
- `f5` — compile F₅ types and permanent (default-on once W4 lands)
- `f7` — compile F₇ types and permanent (default-on once W4 lands)
- `serde` — Serde de/serialization for packed types (default-off)

Cross-feature compatibility: every combination of `{simd,parallel,hip,f5,f7,serde}` must build cleanly.

Output: an updated `Cargo.toml` skeleton fragment in `dev/plans/d1c_feature_matrix.md` plus a CI check matrix recommendation.

## Success Criteria

1. [hard] Decision doc lands in `dev/plans/d1c_feature_matrix.md` and is attached via `jit doc add`.
2. [hard] Every feature is named, defaulted, and described in one line.
3. [hard] A 2^N-cell compatibility matrix lists every feature combination and confirms it builds (verified at the W1 T1 stage by running `cargo check` over the matrix; this issue produces the *plan* for that matrix, T1 exercises it).
4. [hard] The doc explicitly resolves: `simd` propagation to `gf2-kernels-simd`'s own `simd` feature; whether `hip` requires `simd`; default-on status of `f5`/`f7` post-W4.
